Sofia, I've posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, ready to paste into your note to June:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That saved report title needs updating to the new Pellow Home Living name.
- Anyone searching or filtering on "Covey & Lark" may miss PHL records, so the old label should be checked wherever it appears.

I haven't drafted the email itself. If you want, I can create a draft to June (joseilark@pemberline.com) from these bullets.
